message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a light-skinned person with dark hair, glasses, and a light blue medical scrub suit pushing a blue gurney. The gurney's metal base consists of a set of black-framed wheels and an X-shaped height adjustment mechanism. Resting on the flat, light-blue top of the gurney is a thick, orange-brown rectangular book with a thin red bookmark ribbon trailing from its pages. To the right, another person's arm, clad in a white sleeve with a black-and-red armband featuring a circular emblem, reaches into the frame with an open palm in a stopping gesture.

The background is a solid white field with a gray shadow beneath the gurney and the figure pushing it. Large red text across the top reads "TEMPO" with smaller red letters below spelling "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the very top, two headlines appear: "Main Kasus Perwira Polisi H.66" and "Peta Baru Industri Televisi H.76". At the bottom, large black text reads "JALAN PINTAS OMNIBUS KESEHATAN" above a smaller paragraph mentioning the "Menteri Kesehatan" and "Ikatan Dokter Indonesia." A barcode, QR code, and price information are in the upper right.
